_comment: Pinned task tools on VM 178, installed by `78-vm-agent-runner.sh install-tools` (download + verify on the Proxmox host; the VM has no general egress). sqfvm mirrors SDG-ARMA3 tools/lab/tools.lock.json (branch feat/runner-lab-access); the install path is the one `a3 lint` expects. member is the full path inside the zip (SDG-ARMA3's lock gives only its basename).

dotnet._comment: Microsoft .NET 8 SDK for SDG-RUST unit tests (owner approved 2026-11-02). From https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/8.0/releases.json, rid linux-x64; sha512 is Microsoft's. Bump version, url and sha512 together.

hemtt._comment: HEMTT for SDG-ARMA3 builds (a3 build / a3 loop), mirrors SDG-ARMA3 tools/lab/tools.lock.json (linux). a3 uses it through SDG_ARMA_HEMTT only when the binary's sha256 matches.

arma_mods._comment: Mod archives SDG-ARMA3 builds unpack, mirrors SDG-ARMA3 tools/lab/mods.lock.json (file name = <name>-<version>.<ext>). Installed read-only by `78-vm-agent-runner.sh seed-arma-mods` (download + sha256 on the Proxmox host). ace is for arena/suites/hc.json. Antistasi is left out: its suite needs 7z, which the VM does not have.
